data.long_meaning: The name Alverson is derived from the Old English elements alf, meaning 'all' or 'elf' and son, meaning 'son'. The name Alverson carries the meaning “Exalted son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alverson usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
